text: Make an 8-second vertical promo for our Lantern Night, with glowing lanterns after dark. Put the date and venue big on screen so people know when and where to come. No voiceover. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?
